errors.what: Foot path is a rounded, near-circular kidney shape that goes around the frame rather than Jansen's flat-bottomed walking path; the foot revolves with the crank (y from about -64 to +56 mm) instead of staying below the frame with a flat ground stroke. Suggests wrong assembly configuration or link lengths.
Leg triangle and upper triangle fold over and bunch up near the fixed pivots (links nearly overlapping, leg pointing up/sideways), unlike a leg that hangs downward.
